# jamfplatform_device_erase (Action)

Requests that Jamf Platform erase a managed device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_device_erase" "return_device_to_service" {
  config {
    device_id = "uuid-of-device-to-erase"

    # Optional erase request fields – remove or adjust as needed.
    preserve_data_plan       = true
    disallow_proximity_setup = false
    clear_activation_lock    = true
    return_to_service        = true
    pin                      = "123456"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) UUID of the device to erase.

### Optional

- `clear_activation_lock` (Boolean) Clear the Activation Lock for the device (mobile devices only).
- `disallow_proximity_setup` (Boolean) Disable Proximity Setup on the next reboot for supported mobile devices.
- `pin` (String) Six-digit Find My PIN required for macOS erase operations.
- `preserve_data_plan` (Boolean) Preserve eSIM data plans on supported iPhone or iPad devices.
- `return_to_service` (Boolean) Return the device to service after erase completes (mobile devices only).
